module.name: smartptrs
module.short: Smart pointers based on management operators: TScoped, TArc and TWeak.

descr.p: The unit provides automatic lifetime management for class instances using the management operators of advanced records (Initialize, Finalize, AddRef, Copy):

ul.li: TScoped - unique ownership, the counterpart of C++ std::unique_ptr. Removes the need for try..finally Free around local objects.
TArc - atomically reference counted shared ownership, the counterpart of std::shared_ptr and Rust Arc, for any TObject descendant.
TWeak - a non-owning reference to an object held by TArc, used to break reference cycles.

descr.p: All three types accept class types only (T: class). Access the object through the Obj property or the Get method.
Temporaries of managed types that are not assigned to a variable (for example W.Lock.Obj) live until the end of the routine in which they were created and keep their reference until then.

element.name: ESmartPtrError
element.short: Raised when a TScoped that owns an object is copied.

descr.p: A copy of an owning TScoped would free the object twice. Assignment, passing by value and copying of dynamic arrays or records that contain an owning TScoped raise this exception; neither source nor destination is changed.

element.name: TScoped
element.short: Exclusive owner of an object; frees it when the record is finalized.

descr.p: The object is freed when a local variable goes out of scope (also while an exception unwinds the stack), when the class or record that contains the field is destroyed, or when a dynamic array that contains it is released.

Ownership cannot be duplicated: pass TScoped as const, constref or var, and transfer ownership with Move, Release or Reset. Copying an owning instance raises ESmartPtrError; copying an empty one is allowed and is equivalent to Reset.
TScoped is not thread-safe; it is meant to be owned by one thread at a time.

element.name: TScoped.Create
element.short: Returns a TScoped that owns AObj.

descr.p: When assigned to a variable (S := TScoped.Create(X)), the object previously owned by that variable is freed.

element.name: TScoped.Reset
element.short: Frees the owned object and takes ownership of AObj.

descr.p: With AObj = nil the owned object is only freed. Passing the object that is already owned does nothing.

element.name: TScoped.Release
element.short: Gives up ownership without freeing the object and returns it.

descr.p: The caller becomes responsible for freeing the returned object. The TScoped is empty afterwards.

element.name: TScoped.Move
element.short: Transfers ownership to the result.

descr.p: B := A.Move leaves A empty and frees the object previously owned by B. A := A.Move is a no-op.

element.name: TScoped.Swap
element.short: Exchanges the owned objects of two TScoped instances.

element.name: TScoped.IsAssigned
element.short: True if an object is owned.

element.name: TScoped.Get
element.short: Returns the owned object without transferring ownership.

element.name: TScoped.Obj
element.short: The owned object (nil if empty).

element.name: TArcBlock
element.short: Control block shared by all TArc and TWeak instances of one object.

descr.p: Strong counts TArc owners; the object is freed when it reaches zero. Weak counts TWeak references plus one reference held collectively by all strong owners; the block is disposed of when it reaches zero. The block is an implementation detail.

element.name: TArc
element.short: Atomically reference counted shared owner of an object.

descr.p: Copies of a TArc share one object and one control block. Copying, passing by value and finalization update the strong count with interlocked operations; the object is freed exactly once, in the thread that releases the last reference. The class does not have to descend from TInterfacedObject.

Different TArc variables referring to the same object may be used concurrently from any threads. A single TArc variable is not thread-safe: a write to it (assignment, Reset) concurrent with any other access must be synchronized. The data of the owned object is not protected by TArc.
Do not create two TArc control blocks for the same object (for example TArc.Create(Other.Obj)): copy the TArc instead.

element.name: TArc.Create
element.short: Starts reference counting AObj with a strong count of one.

descr.p: Ownership of AObj is transferred to the result; if the control block cannot be allocated, AObj is freed and the exception is re-raised. When assigned to a variable, the reference previously held by that variable is released.

element.name: TArc.Reset
element.short: Releases this reference and optionally starts owning AObj.

descr.p: Releasing the last reference frees the object. Passing the object that is already owned does nothing.

element.name: TArc.IsAssigned
element.short: True if an object is referenced.

element.name: TArc.Get
element.short: Returns the shared object.

element.name: TArc.Obj
element.short: The shared object (nil if empty).

element.name: TArc.UseCount
element.short: Number of TArc owners of the object.

descr.p: A snapshot that may be outdated by the time it is used in multi-threaded code; intended for diagnostics and tests. Returns 0 for an empty TArc.

element.name: TArc.op_Equal
element.short: True if both refer to the same object (or both are empty).

element.name: TArc.op_NotEqual
element.short: True if the operands refer to different objects.

element.name: TWeak
element.short: Non-owning reference to an object owned by TArc.

descr.p: A TWeak keeps the control block alive but not the object. Lock returns a TArc that owns the object, or an empty TArc if all owners are gone. Use TWeak for back references (child to parent, observer lists, caches) to avoid reference cycles that would never be freed.
The same thread-safety rules as for TArc apply.

element.name: TWeak.TArcT
element.short: The TArc specialization with the same type parameter.

element.name: TWeak.Create
element.short: Returns a weak reference to the object owned by A.

element.name: TWeak.Assign
element.short: Starts observing the object owned by A.

element.name: TWeak.Reset
element.short: Stops observing the object.

element.name: TWeak.Lock
element.short: Atomically obtains a strong reference.

descr.p: The strong count is incremented only from a non-zero value, so an object whose last owner is gone is never resurrected: the result either owns a live object, which stays alive while the result is held, or is empty.

element.name: TWeak.TryLock
element.short: Same as Lock; returns True if the object is still alive.

element.name: TWeak.Expired
element.short: True if the object has been freed or nothing is observed.

descr.p: A snapshot: in multi-threaded code use TryLock to both check and use the object.

element.name: MakeScoped
element.short: Returns a TScoped that owns AObj; T is inferred from the argument.

descr.p: With {$modeswitch implicitfunctionspecialization}: S := MakeScoped(TStringList.Create). Same semantics as TScoped.Create: the object previously owned by the destination is freed. Available when the compiler defines FPC_HAS_CONSTRAINED_GENERIC_FORWARD.

element.name: MakeArc
element.short: Returns a TArc that owns AObj; T is inferred from the argument.

descr.p: Same semantics as TArc.Create. Available when the compiler defines FPC_HAS_CONSTRAINED_GENERIC_FORWARD.
